# Discovery Canvas — Clinic Network Booking

| # | Section | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Customers | Olena — clinic network COO, sponsor `[kickoff notes]` · Clients — people booking care `[kickoff notes]` · Specialists — practitioners delivering appointments `[kickoff notes]` |
| 2 | Problems | P-1 — Clients call to book and ~30% of calls go unanswered; the booking is lost `[kickoff notes]` · P-2 — Specialists lose income to late cancellations they learn about by phone `[kickoff notes]` |
| 3 | Product.The | Clinic Network Booking `[presale brief]` |
| 4 | Product.Is | A self-service booking surface for a clinic network `[presale brief]` |
| 5 | Product.That | Lets a Client secure a Specialist's published time without phoning the clinic `[presale brief]` |
| 6 | Forms | Responsive web `[kickoff notes]` |
| 7 | Core Functions | Browse a Specialist's published Availability `→ O-2` · Book an available Slot `→ O-2` · Cancel own Appointment `→ O-2` · Availability published by Specialists or their Clinic Admins `→ O-2` `[call 2026-07-14]` · Notify the Specialist of bookings and cancellations `→ O-2` `[kickoff notes]` |
| 8 | Third-Party Connections | Specialists' external calendars — the Specialist's schedule lives there and booked Appointments must be visible in it; direction — outbound: appointment events mirrored to the calendar the Specialist already keeps `[kickoff notes]` |
| 9 | Localization | One interface language at launch — the network's home language; regions: the network's clinics, one country; currencies: `N/A — no payment surface in MVP scope` `[presale brief · canvas: Objectives O-1]` |
| 10 | Competition.Unlike | Phone-and-paper scheduling at the incumbent clinics · general-purpose calendar booking tools `[kickoff notes]` |
| 11 | Competition.Our Solution | Booking completes without a phone call — unlike phone-and-paper scheduling at the incumbent clinics, no attempt is lost to an unanswered line `→ P-1` `→ O-2` `[canvas: Competition.Unlike · competitive-analysis.md]` |
| 12 | Objectives | O-1 — MVP live this year `[kickoff notes]` `→ P-1` · O-2 — reduce lost bookings; baseline: the ~30% unanswered-call rate `[kickoff notes]` `→ P-1` |
| 13 | Context/Constraints | Technical — the calendars Specialists already keep stay in place `[constraints.md §1]` · Business — launch is tied to the autumn season `[constraints.md §2]` · Regulatory — the product handles no medical-record data `[constraints.md §3]` |
